interpretation.samplingMethod: Upper endplate width anchors scale independently for each level; other body and pedicle parameters derive as dimensionless ratios to width.
interpretation.limits: Matching model design ratios is NOT evidence that mesh or facet surfaces have medically valid dimensions. Confirm by landmark/CT shape registration and anatomical expert review.

calibration.anchor: Set project-units-per-mm using L3 superior endplate width / (2 * project L3 W=8.10)
calibration.sourceToModelConversion: Upper endplate widths, depths, and anterior body heights map to design half-extents; pedicle widths/heights and spinal canal widths map to preliminary section parameters only.
calibration.caution: Endplate top/bottom width differ; primitive SDF radial margins and bone unions affect final surface; parameter match is NOT mesh-surface match. Require independent mesh-section measurement and landmark registration.
